# fp1-relabel-swapped

**Origin:** authored for this repository, generated byte for byte by a
script and checked in as bytes. Not a third-party work.
**Licence:** MIT, as with the rest of the repository.

## Why it is here

The same onsets as fp1-relabel-original with every code relabelled (0A, ZZ)
and the WAV definitions renamed. A code is an onset unless it is exactly 00,
so nothing moves.

One half of a pair with `fp1-relabel-original`. Each chart is asserted
against its own value; the pair exists so that an implementation which tells
the two apart fails on at least one of them.

An fp1 fixture, chosen for what it exercises in the algorithm rather than as
music. It is not a template for a good chart.
